title.narrative: Progress towards peace in Yemen through security sector stabilisation

description.narrative: Conflict parties discuss security issues to build trust and foster security sector stabilisation at local, regional and international levels (outcome 1) by 1) enhancing dialogue between conflict actors to support the UN-led peace process and 2) improving information sharing on security trends by providing a space for relevant local, regional and international stakeholders, including Yemeni CSOs, OSESGY and peacebuilding partners, to share information on the latest security dynamics, allowing them to adapt their approach and/or create synergies. Decision-making processes related to ongoing peace efforts are informed by leading research on SSS (outcome 2) by 1) improving capacity of Yemeni researchers to carry out SSS studies and 2) publicating of leading studies on emerging SSS priorities.

Since its inception, our programme in Yemen has been working towards 2 complementary objectives: a) addressing immediate security challenges facing civilians by supporting short-term initiatives; and b) supporting a vision for longer-term security arrangements through gradual confidence-building between all conflict actors. Through our long-term engagement, we have built trusted relationships with our Yemeni partners across political, tribal and geographical divides and informed the UN-led peace process thanks to our strategic partnership with UN OSESGY. By allowing space for security dialogue, we encourage the creation of a more conducive environment that contributes to the ongoing peace process and supports additional safeguards for all Yemenis
